findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1181 post-claim one-shot intake occurs outside the worker error/finalization boundary; a missing or corrupt input.env.json, prompt, or capability file throws before lines 1204-1206 unlink the files, leaving plaintext prompt/capability/environment artifacts and a running non-terminal snapshot until deadline. A built-code reproduction left TOP_SECRET_PROMPT and all three one-shot files present after claim, violating CHK-002 adversarial secrecy and the documented immediate failed-startup cleanup.

packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1724 reapManagedHostRunProviderProcess re-reads the PGID after TERM but does not revalidate the original leader and startFingerprint before SIGKILL at line 1729. A built-code seam where the original group disappeared and the PGID was reused still emitted SIGKILL and reported reaped=true, so reconciliation can signal an unrelated process group and authorize replacement using false cleanup facts.

packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:2313 retention GC unconditionally removes the cross-host snapshot even though the normal cross_host_review path already removes it in packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts:1033. cleanupManagedCrossHostReviewWorktree is non-idempotent; a built-code second cleanup failed with “is not a working tree”, so otherwise-valid expired cross-host runs enter failed[] and their heavy runtime is never archived or removed.

packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1742 next-touch reconciliation has no reconcile-level lock: concurrent status and cancel callers can both pass the same deadline or cancellation checks and independently TERM/KILL/reap before writeTerminal serializes only the final file. This violates plan.md:20's single short reconcile.lock contract and makes cleanup side effects and audit facts race even though terminal.json remains exclusive.

packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:994 rejects unsupported platforms before allocating a runId or runtime artifacts, so callers receive only a thrown error and cannot inspect an explicit terminal or receipt. plan.md:41 requires a structured unsupported-platform terminal before spawn; packages/main/src/tasks/managed-host-run-smoke.ts:126 currently codifies the weaker thrown-error behavior.

readManifest.scanEscalationReason: Candidate routing omitted newly protected managed-run and managed-review-evidence sources, so the review escalated to the changed-file inventory and fully read the lifecycle and evidence modules needed to validate receipt, secrecy, retention, and process-safety behavior.
